task_refinements.supersedes: Only SN-031 decomposition and explicit paired SN-032 depends_on/interfaces.consumes replacement; all expected baseline values must match.

composition_rules: Verify exact hashes and expected dependency preconditions before assembly.
Preserve all base requirements and AC; add the required MCP source, never replace or silently omit it.
SN-031 is aggregate_only; paid dispatch only of separately admitted children with accepted prerequisites.

Apply only explicit task_overrides after checking expected_depends_on and, for SN-032, exact expected_interfaces_consumes; replace depends_on and interfaces.consumes together. Preserve every unspecified field, including produces, and all existing controls.
Interpret this as one versioned planning source, not a second queue or a completed native importer.
Unsupported refinement causes a planning hold; it does not authorise replay of any specifically refused operation.
Final milestone retains all MCP requirements, human-only auth/consent constraints and cloud-client acceptance.

Validate the effective union of depends_on and interfaces.consumes.task as a cycle-free prerequisite graph; each consumed task must already be a direct or transitive dependency. Reject unsupported override fields rather than dropping them.
